title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: In a moonlit library-reef of glowing anemones and miniature arches, this inky little octopus rearranges pebble poems each night and waves a curious arm at every passerby. It collects shiny commas, naps in a teacup coral, and never met a puzzle—or a person—it didn't want to explore gently.
